verdict.rationale: App-lock via biometrics or PIN is a fair question for a password manager and authenticator, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents Bitwarden's app or vault locking behind biometrics or a PIN. The only nearby item is a community wish for fingerprint auth on Linux (bitwarden-comm-11), which only hints that fingerprint unlock exists elsewhere. It does not document a mobile app lock protecting codes, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
